availability_note: Unknown for November 13, November 6, November 20 and November 12, 2027; no outreach or holds.
pricing_method: Published components are not full wedding quotes. Dated prices use 4% annual escalation to 2027 for planning only; undated price years remain unknown. No confirmed savings or budget reductions.

sections.title: Food, catering staff and required charges
sections.budget_scope: Within complete venue-driven shopping target $30,000 / hard cap $32,139, together with venue, hosted bar, cake, rentals and tax. Outside caterers require venue approval. No complete quote establishes budget fit.

vendors.name: MISSION BBQ
vendors.published_price: Party Pack $17.54/person; XL $23.79/person, plus tax; staff $35/hour each; allow two hours setup/breakdown; gratuity additional.
vendors.scope: BBQ food packages and disposables; staffed buffet service and equipment can be added. First inquiry for food value.
vendors.gaps: Local-store applicability; 185 guests; cocktail-hour food; dietary needs; staff count/hours; delivery; tax/gratuity; china/glasses/flatware and guest linens; room setup/flip, bussing/strike; hosted bar and coffee not established.
vendors.budget_status: Promising component pricing; complete venue and food-service fit requires quote. No all-in price inferred.

vendors.name: IndAroma
vendors.published_price: Typical $14,000 event for about 250 guests; Saturday/peak minimums higher. Not a $56/person rate and not a 185-guest quote.
vendors.scope: Buffet/family-style service, kitchen and waitstaff, rentals/equipment, and professional bar service can be itemized together; client usually supplies alcohol.
vendors.gaps: Saturday minimum; 185-person menu; exact rentals and labor; fees/gratuity/tax/travel; alcohol and bar supplies; venue approval. Taking 2027 weddings is not date availability.
vendors.budget_status: Strong integrated-service inquiry; complete price and budget fit unknown.

vendors.name: Catering At Your Door
vendors.price_year: 2024 linked April menus; matching webpage prices undated
vendors.published_price: Supreme BBQ $32.95/person at 100+; chef up to 4 hours with 1.5 hours serving. Waitstaff $212/4 hours plus $53/hour thereafter. FAQ adds 20% gratuity or specified fixed amount, travel and applicable food tax. Beverage options $3/person each; bar setup $4/person with client alcohol.
vendors.scope: BBQ with chef, separately priced waitstaff and beverage components; useful alternative for an approved outside-catering hall.
vendors.gaps: 2027 tariff and complete wedding service; cocktail food; extended hours; rentals and china; bartenders; ice/glassware; travel; cleanup. Confirm included gratuity once and avoid duplicate assumed charges.
vendors.budget_status: Partial dated menu, not full quote. Escalate dated components 4% annually only for planning; full fit unproven.

sections.recommendation: Compare these three against the selected venue's caterer using identical 185-person scope. Prefer one accountable food/bar service team when the complete price is competitive. Retain all existing allowances until staffing, service, tax, rentals and logistics are covered.

sections.title: Hosted beer and wine, bartenders and nonalcoholic drinks
sections.budget_scope: Inside complete venue envelope, not an additional budget. Require 185-person capacity and hosted beer/wine; smaller published packages do not establish a wedding price.

vendors.name: Cartistry
vendors.published_price: $799 for 51–100 guests, two bartenders, up to four hours; not a 185-person package.
vendors.scope: Dry-hire bartending with setup/breakdown; client supplies alcohol.
vendors.gaps: 185-person capacity/staff/price; bar table, ice, cups and mixers add-ons; full table bussing and venue cleaning excluded; travel/tax, insurance/venue authorization and legal purchasing arrangement must be confirmed.
vendors.budget_status: Custom 185-person quote required; no extrapolation from smaller tier.

vendors.name: Sunrise Rentals DMV
vendors.published_price: Deluxe Grand Bar $1,120 or mobile bar $1,360; three hours, two bartenders, up to 150 guests. Extra hour $180; beverage essentials +$5/person.
vendors.scope: Bar equipment and service; client alcohol; setup/cleanup and specified disposables.
vendors.gaps: 185-person upgrade/capacity; full hours; travel/tax; glassware; venue approval. Package and FAQ conflict on ice/mixers, requiring written reconciliation. Coffee/tea not established.
vendors.budget_status: Published tier excludes our guest count; complete price unknown.

vendors.name: Total Wine & More — retail support only
vendors.price_year: unknown; products and local store pricing depend on selection
vendors.published_price: Free wedding consultation; no 185-person hosted-beer/wine price published.
vendors.scope: Possible beer/wine retailer after venue/caterer purchasing rules permit it. Consultation does not include alcohol, staff or bar service.
vendors.gaps: Permitted purchase location and owner; adult drinkers; service duration; products, quantities, local tax, pickup/delivery, ice/storage and returns. Do not use default out-of-state website prices.
vendors.budget_status: Retail sourcing option only; full alcohol cost unknown and separate from bartending quote.

sections.recommendation: First price bar service with IndAroma or the chosen caterer; Cartistry and Sunrise are standalone alternatives requiring custom capacity confirmation. Assign all water, soft drinks, coffee/tea, ice, equipment and replenishment once. Venue and licensed provider must identify applicable permissions and fees.

sections.title: Wedding cake, tasting, delivery and cutting
sections.budget_scope: Current model allowances within venue envelope: cake $1,480 + tasting/delivery $150 + cutting $370. Published components do not replace these allowances until complete quotes arrive.

vendors.name: Heidelberg Pastry Shoppe — traditional wedding cake
vendors.published_price: $5.50/serving base; tasting $20; delivery from $40. 185 base servings $1,017.50; cake+tasting+minimum delivery $1,077.50 raw / $1,212.04 after 4% annual escalation to 2027.
vendors.scope: Traditional buttercream wedding cake with base flavors/fillings. Raw and escalated totals are partial estimates only.
vendors.gaps: 2027 quote; design, premium flavors/fillings, actual delivery mileage/time, tax, stand, top-tier retention and cake cutting/service. Detailed dated sheet takes precedence over older conflicting introductory price.
vendors.budget_status: Promising within $1,630 cake/tasting/delivery baseline before unresolved costs; no saving secured. Cutting separately retained.

vendors.name: Classic Bakery — traditional wedding cake
vendors.published_price: From $7/serving at 75+ servings and three tiers; delivery from $100. Tasting $60 credited toward order. 185 base servings + minimum delivery = $1,395 before tax/upgrades/actual travel/cutting.
vendors.scope: Traditional cake with base filling, icing and decoration; delivery priced separately.
vendors.gaps: 2027 tariff and design; delivery mileage; tax; cutting/service; optional stand rental and refundable deposit if needed. Avoid counting credited tasting twice.
vendors.budget_status: Published partial floor suggests possible baseline fit; undated tariff and full quote remain unknown.

vendors.name: Heidelberg Pastry Shoppe — optional small cutting cake and sheets
vendors.published_price: Group B 6-inch round $23.95 (6–8 servings), full sheet $220 (80–120), quarter sheet $69 (20–30). Two full + one quarter + 6-inch round: minimum 186 stated servings, $532.95 raw / $648.42 after five years at 4%.
vendors.scope: Optional presentation change with small display/cutting cake and sheet portions. Sheet cakes are not layered; differs from traditional wedding cake.
vendors.gaps: Old price sheet; baker-approved wedding portions, design, actual 2027 price, tasting, delivery, tax and cutting/service. Couple must choose this presentation before implementation.
vendors.budget_status: Illustrative saving opportunity only, not a quote or approved design substitution. Keep allowances intact.

sections.recommendation: Quote Heidelberg traditional first and Classic second. Keep sheet-cake route optional. Venue/caterer separately owns cutting, plating, service and dessert dishes unless expressly included.

sections.title: Meals for the working vendor team
sections.budget_scope: $400 separate approved allowance; roughly ten workers is an unconfirmed planning assumption.

vendors.name: Selected caterer — MISSION BBQ, IndAroma or Catering At Your Door if venue-approved
vendors.published_price: No dedicated wedding vendor-meal price established; $400 is the internal allowance, not a supplier quote.
vendors.scope: Add contracted working-crew meals to the same caterer's proposal and schedule.
vendors.gaps: Actual crew headcount including assistants, hot-meal requirements, timing/dietary needs, tax and fees; prevent double counting in the 185 guest count.
vendors.budget_status: Must fit $400 or be offset within the approved plan after complete quote; no reserve use.

sections.recommendation: Use the selected caterer, not a separate delivery service. Coordinator collects vendor contract meal counts and schedules service with the caterer. Late-night snack remains optional and unfunded.
